identity: Kapok raises its young among the yam beds, and somebody keeps stealing the rain's offerings.

quests.title: Roots Before Teeth
quests.text: Small Jungle Boars dig up the {name:yam_beds} {dir_of:kapok:yam_beds} by day. Bring down eight; their yellow names mean they only fight when you start it. And keep an eye out: somebody keeps taking the little offerings we leave for the rain, and a boar never ate a carved bead.
quests.lesson: Yellow names are neutral single pulls.

quests.title: What Comes Out After Dark
quests.text: When the sun goes down the Large Kapok Rats take over the same {name:yam_beds}. Kill eight after nightfall and mind the gaps between them: one squeak and its cousins come running.
quests.lesson: The same area holds a day and a night roster; rats call nearby rats.

quests.title: Dead Feet in the Rootways
quests.text: Braindead Zombies shuffle through the {name:rootways} {zone_area:rootways} at night, among the rats. Put six of them back in the ground. Any you miss will try the sunrise, and the sun is a poor host to the dead.
quests.lesson: Zombies come out at night and burn in the sun.

quests.title: Tusks in the Thornwood
quests.text: Past the broadleaf trees the {name:thornwood} grows mean, and so do its boars. Kill eight Aggressive Jungle Boars there by day {zone_area:thornwood}. Red names come for you, so do not walk into two at once, and watch the vines for the Monstrous Vipers that share the ground.
quests.lesson: Red names attack on sight; a minor role shares the area.

quests.title: The Offering Thieves
quests.text: Now I know where the rain offerings went. The Confused Offering Thieves camp at the {name:thieves_camp} {dir_from_giver:thieves_camp}, and their chief Tangle sells our beads back to travellers as lucky charms. Drive off six of them, settle Tangle, and the rain can have its due again.
quests.lesson: A camp keeps refilling; its named chief stands at the centre.

quests.title: The Road to Raincall
quests.text: The cradle has taught you what it can. Daro Kapok keeps Raincall Village along the road out of the jungle, and the basin always needs another pair of hands when the rains come. Go and tell him Zalima sent you.

quests.title: A Handle for Everything
quests.text: Make a Wooden Axe and a Wooden Pickaxe and bring both to me. I will look them over and give you back a pair; a spear does not cut a tree and a fist does not cut a stone.
quests.lesson: Basic grid tools; the reward replaces the tools handed in.

quests.title: Stone Under the Moss
quests.text: Use your wooden pick on the rock under the moss outside town and make a Stone Axe and a Stone Pickaxe. Bring both; I will hand back a pair for the ore work ahead.
quests.lesson: Tool progression; check the rock's required pick tier.

quests.title: Copper and Tin
quests.text: Dig copper and tin out of the rock, smelt them, and bring me three Copper Bars and three Tin Bars. The rain rusts what is careless, so we start with metal that forgives.
quests.lesson: Mining and the furnace: one lump, one bar.

quests.title: Bronze for the Basin
quests.text: Bring three Bronze Bars. Copper and tin go into a dual furnace together and come out stronger, which is also how the best marriages in Kapok work.

quests.title: Wood for the Pot
quests.text: Bring me five logs from any tree outside town. The pot does not care which tree, and neither do I, as long as it burns.
quests.lesson: Any log counts; planks do not. Town plants are protected.

quests.title: A Proper Fire
quests.text: Bring five Coal Lumps from the rock outside town. Coal goes in the oven's fuel slot and the food goes in the cooking slot; mix them up once and you eat charcoal for a week.
quests.lesson: Gather while waiting for night; the public oven is in town.

quests.title: Cooked, Not Just Warm
quests.text: You have been carrying Raw Meat since the yam beds. Cook five pieces in the oven by my hearth and bring me the Meat. A hunter who can cook never goes hungry, and never goes unvisited.
quests.lesson: The public oven turns Raw Meat into Meat.

quests.title: Patches for the Sacks
quests.text: The rats chewed my yam sacks to lace. Bring two Rat Fur Patches from the Large Kapok Rats in the {name:yam_beds} and I will stitch the holes with their own coats. Keep any spare patches; armour likes them too.
quests.lesson: Drops can be gathered while doing another quest.

quests.title: Crab for the Feast
quests.text: Small Crabs scuttle in the {name:shallows} {dir_from_giver:shallows}. Bring two Crab Legs; they only pinch back if you pinch first, which is more manners than most guests have.
quests.lesson: Shore regions are narrow strips along the water.

quests.title: Sinew for the Drying Racks
quests.text: Young Tapirs graze the {name:broadleaf_wood} {zone_area:broadleaf_wood} by day. Bring two Fine Sinews to tie my drying racks. Careful: Aggressive Jungle Lynxes hunt the same leaves, and they do not wait to be asked.
quests.lesson: A neutral main role next to an aggressive minor role.
